question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"through."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"To live through"** means to survive or endure a difficult or challenging experience.
 
• When someone has lived through something, it means they have experienced it and come out on the other side, often implying that the experience was intense, trying, or emotionally significant.
 
• It can refer to various situations, such as a crisis, a traumatic event, a difficult period in one's life, or any challenging circumstance that a person has managed to survive and overcome.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

My breath is halted, like gasping for air after__ crying far too long and hard. It is like a hiccup, with a shivering sharpness __of__ nerves. It is like icicles running __down__ your spine or aluminum in your mouth, an eerie amount of emotions that cannot compare __to__ the actual feelings you’ve managed to live __**through**__. I just watched you die; I say to myself silently.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "within",** means inside or contained within something. ((समयावधि की सीमा) के अंदर))
 
• **Option 3, "out",** means away from the inside of something. (बाहर (किसी स्‍थान के भीतरी भाग से दूर))
 
• **Option 4, "instead", **means in place of or as an alternative to something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍थान पर)
